name: crust-mcp

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search a supported Google surface via CrustAPI and get clean, structured JSON. Choose the surface with `type`: maps (local businesses with ratings/phone/website), places (lean local pack), news, shopping, images, scholar, patents, or autocomplete (query suggestions). Results come back in structured JSON. Empty results are free.

q.description: The search query, e.g. 'dentists in Miami'.

gl.description: Country code (us, gb, de, ...). Default us. Not used by maps.

location.description: City/region for local results, e.g. 'Austin, TX'.

limit.description: type=maps only: how many businesses to return (billed per returned business).

tools.name: scrape_webpage
tools.description: Fetch any URL and get back clean readable text, page metadata, and JSON-LD, ready for RAG. A failed fetch is free.

url.description: The page URL to scrape, e.g. 'https://example.com/article'.

includeMarkdown.description: Also return the page rendered as Markdown.

tools.name: get_reviews
tools.description: Get Google reviews for a business. Identify the place by placeId, cid, or fid, or just pass a business-name query `q` and CrustAPI resolves it. Supports sorting and pagination. Pay only for successful results.

q.description: Business name to resolve to a place (use this OR placeId/cid/fid).

nextPageToken.description: Cursor from a previous response to fetch the next page.

tools.name: linkedin
tools.description: Get public LinkedIn data via CrustAPI as clean structured JSON. Choose the surface with `type`: profile (a person's full public profile by URL, with work history, education, and skills), company (company details by URL), posts (recent posts from a profile or company URL), jobs (search listings by keywords + optional location, or one job's full detail by URL), or search (find people by keywords; add enrich=true to return each person's full profile). Empty results are free.

url.description: A linkedin.com/in/ or /company/ URL (profile, company, posts), or a job URL (jobs).

enrich.description: type=search: also fetch each person's full profile (billed per returned full profile).

employees.description: type=company: also return a sample of employees.

comments.description: type=posts: also return per-post comment counts.
